title: Fairness for AUC via Feature Augmentation
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on a mathematical approach to achieving fairness in machine learning classification, measured by the Area Under the Curve (AUC), with experiments conducted on datasets concerning criminal justice and healthcare.
